key: Notes by a Certain Noble Individual
0.content: The Belyi Tsar wrote six sets of notes in the Pale Crown Palace about his expeditions into the Shadow Realm. In the second he blames the Saint's folly for Hyperborea's destruction. In the third he suspects the Shadow Realm was made by the Saint, as a film separating Teyvat from the Abyss. In the fourth he reverses himself: the city's fate was fixed before the Saint came, the Saint sought the light of the world's genesis, and those faithful to the future bought only thirty years. In the fifth he calls himself the posthumous child of that first light.
